answer_1.quote: Chess commentary generation is generating a comment for a chess move.
datasets: Chess Commentary dataset introduced by Jhamtani et al. (2018)

answer_2.quote: We introduce and validate an LLM-based evaluation metric to assess the quality of chess commentary across multiple dimensions.

answer_3.quote: We propose an LLM-based evaluation metric to assess the quality of chess commentary across multiple dimensions.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a manual human evaluation to assess the quality of the generated chess commentary.
answer_4.guideline: Each participant was asked to rate the commentary across six questions: five evaluation metrics and one question for categorizing the type of incorrectness when applicable.
